lines.t:
A <c:ffff00>{{damage_trait}}<c> that deals <c:ffff00>{{damage}}<c> to all <c:ffff00>slots<c> at
once.

The {{damage}} is split equally among the {{opponent}}'s
<c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c> that aren't <c:ffff00>destroyed<c>.

It isn't compatible with the <c:ffff00>{{pierce|cap}}<c> {{damage_trait}}.
